tidal-colossus.written: The whole sea sweeps the rows. Wide Reach and row wards turn the waves; who stands where?
tidal-colossus.measured: Cover, Reach Knacks, protection talents, Row Ward Knacks, Area hit

cinder-wyrm.written: The forge turns the first reaction of every row back on you, and every reaction heats it. Keep Mired on it, or make each reaction count.
cinder-wyrm.measured: Debuff Knacks, Mired, Armour, Taunt, Cover

thornmother.written: The row ends fall quiet. Keep what you cannot spare in the middle or ward it, and bring something for her thick bark.
thornmother.measured: Armour, Detonator Knacks, Marks, Pierce Knacks, Taunt

storm-sovereign.written: The Rod leaps from the strongest Payoff, round after round, and a Judgement Bolt, announced at round start, can fell it. Draw the Rod onto something that can take it, and have Night Watch beside the Payoff for the Bolt.
storm-sovereign.measured: Debuff Knacks, Mired, Armour, Support shape Knacks, Cover

old-bogback.written: The fen pulls the most hurt creature down. Keep them up, and keep the Mired on it.
old-bogback.measured: Sustain Knacks, Cover, Row Ward Knacks, Area hit, Support shape Knacks

puddle-imp.written: Many small splashes on random creatures: dodge turns them away, armour only wears them down.

drift-wisp.written: Hard to hit, it keeps the ends of the line quiet, and every miss thickens the fog. Something must ward the ends.

ember-mite.written: Its heat sheds your marks after every turn of its own, and each mark shed warms it. A sealed mark stays, and so does one left during its own turn.

ash-sprite.written: Ash settles on a mark made by a reaction, so it cannot be cashed at once, and the fight is long: a Guard that builds Heat doubles a reaction every few rounds.

bramble-hound.written: Bark turns small hits away, and it silences the ends of the line. Tunnel Through or a big hit gets past.

moss-lurker.written: It likes the loudest visitor: the one that dealt the most, and the strongest. A Guard beside it takes the hit.

static-bat.written: No hit deals more than a cap, it dives at the hardest hitter, and every crit on it charges it. Dodge keeps the team standing while it hits often.

flicker-swarm.written: Sparks everywhere: area hits on all three, every round. A row ward cuts every one of them.

bog-toad.written: It washes every debuff off itself every third round: a Mired that comes back every round holds it down.

tar-leech.written: Black, thick and draining: healing is halved and little gets through its armour, so a boost that reaches every hitter gets more through than a heal; its heavy hits are dodged, not healed.

drowned-warden.written: The gates open on the whole line, and each creature that falls lets the water rise; at a landmark, a wave announced at round start.

slag-tyrant.written: The first reaction after each of its turns burns the one who plays it, and every reaction heats it. A Mired that comes back every round holds its Molten Shell down.

bramble-matron.written: She silences the ends and drains healing; thorns land on two random creatures. A Guard that marks as it takes a hit does the Setter’s work.

coil-baron.written: It always goes for the strongest, and the charge builds with every round: a race, where Heat doubles the reactions.

fen-lurker.written: A heavy sweep of the line announced at round start, and it washes off every debuff every third round. Night Watch takes the first Wind-up hit.
